suggestions.title: Optimize Critical Rendering Path for LCP
suggestions.description: The LCP element's load time is significantly delayed due to render-blocking resources and inefficient loading.
suggestions.implementation: Ensure all critical CSS and JS are minimized and loaded in a non-blocking manner. Use `loadEager` for the immediate loading of high-priority elements.

suggestions.title: Defer Third-Party and Unused Scripts
suggestions.description: The auth0-spa-js.production.js script and other unused parts of scripts are affecting load performance.
suggestions.implementation: Implement a conditional loading strategy for third-party scripts, ensuring they're loaded only when necessary. Engage in code-splitting to remove unused parts.

suggestions.title: Tree Shaking and Code Splitting
suggestions.description: JavaScript code contains significant unused portions, contributing to high TBT.
suggestions.implementation: Implement tree shaking and split code by breaking down auth0-spa-js and other similar scripts to ensure only the critical parts are loaded diligently.

suggestions.title: Enhance Image Delivery Tactics
suggestions.implementation: Use fetchpriority='high' and ensure proper dimensions are defined for all LCP images

suggestions.title: Address Long Task Durations
suggestions.description: Scripts causing long tasks are impeding responsiveness.
suggestions.implementation: Refactor event handlers and consider leveraging APIs like window.requestIdleCallback for non-critical tasks.

suggestions.title: Preconnect and Preload Strategy
suggestions.description: Optimize resource fetching with HTTP/2 features.
suggestions.implementation: Implement DNS prefetch and preload strategies for critical domains.
